page_title: NOT 3-1 FUL | Nottingham Forest v Fulham 02/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Michael Oliver has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Adama Traore (Fulham) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
90+3' Divock Origi (Nottingham) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
89' Fulham are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
89' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes.
87' Divock Origi (Nottingham) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
83' It will be a substitution. Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is ready to enter the pitch as Anthony Elanga walks off.
83' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Ola Aina and he is replaced by Harry Toffolo (Nottingham).
79' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) sends an accurate short pass. Willian controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
79' Michael Oliver blows his whistle as Willian (Fulham) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
77' The game has come to an end for Morgan Gibbs-White. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham).
75' Willian (Fulham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
74' Willian (Fulham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
73' Willian (Fulham) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
71' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Andreas Pereira is replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham).
71' Today's match ends for Joao Palhinha who will be replaced by Harrison Reed (Fulham).
71' Kenny Tete (Fulham) sees his header crash off the crossbar after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
71' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

71' Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Matz Sels, who pulls off a stunning save! The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
71' The resulting set piece from Fulham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' Divock Origi (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch after Callum Hudson-Odoi signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
69' The game is interrupted now, Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
68' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Joao Palhinha (Fulham) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
65' Neco Williams (Nottingham) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
63' Having seen unsporting behavior, Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Matt Turner (Nottingham) is the recipient.
63' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nottingham was in an offside position.
61' Tom Cairney (Fulham) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
60' Tom Cairney (Fulham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
59' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Matz Sels comes off his line to gather the ball.
56' Willian (Fulham) works the corner short.
56' One of the Nottingham players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
54' Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
54' A pass by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
52' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

49' 3 - 1 Andreas Pereira takes over corner duties and expertly finds Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the right side of the goal. The score is now 3:1.
49' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is about to take a corner kick.
49' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
49' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The whistle blows and Michael Oliver starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+3' 3 - 0 Goal! Danilo plays in Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 3:0.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.
43' It seemed like Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
43' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a long ball in, but Matz Sels comfortably gathers the ball.
39' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
37' Fulham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
36' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
33' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Willian (Fulham) comes onto the pitch for Harry Wilson.
33' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adama Traore (Fulham) replacing Alex Iwobi.
33' Sasa Lukic will be replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
32' The shots on goal statistics – 3:1.
29' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Harry Wilson (Fulham) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
28' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
25' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
24' Fulham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Chris Wood (Nottingham) tries to play a long through ball into Anthony Elanga, but the defence breaks the move down.

19' 2 - 0 Murillo slides a pass towards Chris Wood (Nottingham) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner. The score is now 2:0.
18' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

18' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is out of play. Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nottingham.
16' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Bernd Leno.
15' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) passes the ball onto Anthony Elanga, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
13' The resulting corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

9' 1 - 0 Goal! A terrific long pass from Morgan Gibbs-White picks out an unmarked Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
7' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Matz Sels sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
6' Great teamplay by Fulham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
Nottingham will kick the game off.
Michael Oliver will supervise the game today.
